post.caption:
A black hole is not a cosmic vacuum cleaner. It is ordinary mass squeezed so small that escaping it would need more than the speed of light. Replace the Sun with one of equal mass and Earth's orbit would not move at all. We would just go dark and cold.

One science idea a day. Follow so you don't miss tomorrow's.
